🎤 At the Lib Dem conference in Brighton, Ed Davey said Reform UK "don't speak for the real United Kingdom".

Well, Lancashire voters gave Reform 53 of 84 seats on the county council. 🗳️ They're nurses, farmers, builders, pensioners. They're every bit as real as anyone in a Brighton conference hall.

And what's the Lib Dem plan? Take Britain back into the single market and customs union. 🇪🇺 That means reversing the heart of what 17.4 million people voted for.

Argue your case, Ed. But don't tell people who disagree with you that they don't count. 👇

Full piece 👉 https://lukeparker.co.uk/articles/davey-reform-dont-speak-for-real-uk-single-market-september-2026.html

#LibDems #ReformUK #Lancashire
